title: DON'T save your jobs on job boards 🔎
description:
If you’re only saving jobs on the boards where you find them there’s a much better way. Since job postings can get pulled without notice you need to have a way to still access the job description and that’s why using a tool like the Teal Chrome Extension is massively beneficial. The tool pulls all the job information off the site and keep it local to the extension so even if something happens to the posting and you can’t find it you still have access to all the information for things like interview preparation. #jobdescription #jobboard #jobsearch #jobsearchtips
